description: Author the single markdown deliverable BILLING-VERIFICATION-PLAN-1477.md at the repo root: a practical, execution-ready test-mode verification plan for the full billing lifecycle across Stripe, Razorpay, and PayU, covering every scope item from GitHub issue #1477. Every file path, env var, table/column, and status value must be verified against the real code (all anchors are pre-verified in context.json's relevant_files and key_findings_and_risks). This is a documentation-only feature: NO product code, tests, or config may be changed. The plan must reference and build on the EXISTING Stripe harness (scripts/billing-lifecycle-test.ts, npm run test:billing) and its runbook (docs/billing-lifecycle-test.md), and must ADD the Razorpay + PayU manual test-mode coverage that those docs explicitly leave as follow-up. This is a standalone, self-contained feature.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/nucrm-bigplan-by-vm-enterprise-v2/BILLING-VERIFICATION-PLAN-1477.md. Start with a title referencing issue #1477 and a short intro noting the three providers and that an automated Stripe harness already exists (scripts/billing-lifecycle-test.ts via `npm run test:billing`, runbook docs/billing-lifecycle-test.md) which this plan extends to Razorpay + PayU and to a full manual test-mode run-through.

PREREQUISITES section: list exact env vars per provider verified from source. Stripe: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (.env.example) plus STRIPE_PRICE_{STARTER,PRO,ENTERPRISE}_{MONTHLY,YEARLY} (lib/stripe.ts L451-460) and the harness-only STRIPE_TEST_SECRET_KEY/APP_URL/TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD/TEST_TENANT_ID/SUPERADMIN_* (scripts/billing-lifecycle-test.ts readConfig). Razorpay: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET (lib/razorpay.ts L111-130). PayU: PAYU_MERCHANT_KEY, PAYU_MERCHANT_SALT, PAYU_MODE=test (lib/payu.ts L25-63). Cron: CRON_SECRET sent as x-cron-secret header (app/api/cron/subscription-check/route.ts L34, lib/auth/cron.ts). Note Razorpay/PayU vars are NOT in .env.example (only documented in lib) and flag that as a doc gap. Give webhook endpoint URLs: POST /api/webhooks/stripe, /api/webhooks/razorpay, /api/webhooks/payu, and how each provider points at them (Stripe CLI `stripe listen --forward-to` / dashboard; Razorpay dashboard webhook + x-razorpay-signature; PayU surl/furl callback form-POST). Note run-in-test-mode via the running app (pm2/nginx or dev), and seed/setup: `npm run seed:dev` (scripts/seed-dev.ts seeds a tenant with planId 'starter'; plans table), and that the dunning retry-cap test needs a real subscriptions row seeded (docs/billing-lifecycle-test.md §7).

For EACH of the 8 scope items from #1477, add a subsection with: (a) precise trigger steps (UI action and/or provider test-mode action and/or `stripe trigger`/dashboard/signed-curl to the webhook), (b) exact DB state to inspect (table.column), (c) EXPECTED result, and (d) an empty 'Actual / Pass-Fail' column. Use tables/checklists. Scope items: (1) Signup->tenant provisioning->plan selection->subscription created; entitlements/limits applied (tenants.status trialing->active, tenants.planId, plan limits via GET /api/tenant/billing/subscription). (2) Subscription lifecycle status mapping. (3) Invoice numbering. (4) Failed payment->dunning. (5) Proration on upgrade/downgrade. (6) Webhook idempotency. (7) Refund/cancellation. (8) Currency/integer-cents.

Add the Stripe status-mapping MATRIX subsection (the #1463 heart) as a table: every Stripe subscription.status -> expected tenants.status, exactly matching app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts handleSubscriptionUpdated switch: active->active, trialing->active, past_due->past_due, canceled->cancelled, unpaid->cancelled, incomplete_expired->cancelled, incomplete->past_due, paused->past_due, unknown/future->past_due (fail-safe, NEVER auto-activate). Add a row for the terminal-status guard: if tenants.status is already suspended/deleted/cancelled, a subscription.updated=active must NOT re-activate (only planId updated). Trigger via `stripe trigger customer.subscription.updated` or a signed relay of buildSubscriptionUpdated fixtures.

Add Razorpay-specific subsection: signature header x-razorpay-signature (lib/razorpay verifyWebhookSignature); events payment.captured/subscription.activated (-> tenants.status='active', planId via normalizeRazorpayPlan growth->pro, scale->enterprise), subscription.cancelled (-> tenants.status='cancelled', planId='free', billingType='trial', metadata.cancelled_at) which is the #1262 cancelled-path (must NOT stay/return active), payment.failed (-> status='past_due'). Idempotency key: razorpay:evt:{id} (x-razorpay-event-id header, fallback payment/subscription entity id), 24h TTL, redelivered within TTL -> {duplicate:true}. Note the plan requires tenant_id in Razorpay notes.

Add PayU-specific subsection: form-POST callback with hash; verifyPayUResponse (PAYU_MERCHANT_SALT). txnid format NUCRM_{quoteId}_{random}; success appends invoice_payments ledger row (payment_method='payu', reference=txnid) and recalculateInvoicePayments sets invoices.status paid + paid_at; quote.status->accepted (unless terminal). Idempotency: per-txnid inside one DB transaction — a duplicate txnid finds an existing invoice_payments.reference row (or invoice already 'paid') and returns alreadyProcessed with NO second ledger row. Failure path records quote.metadata.payu.failures (dedup by txnid).

Add IDEMPOTENCY tests subsection (#1274): for each provider, replay the SAME event id/txnid twice and assert no double-row / double-charge / double-entitlement. State the exact key per provider: Stripe stripe:evt:{event.id} lock (dup -> {received:true,duplicate:true}); Razorpay razorpay:evt:{id} 24h TTL (dup -> {received:true,duplicate:true}); PayU per-txnid transaction check on invoice_payments.reference (dup -> processed:false, alreadyProcessed:true, exactly one invoice_payments row). Note the existing Stripe harness already automates the Stripe duplicate check.

Add INVOICE-NUMBER concurrency test subsection (#1462): create N invoices concurrently (e.g. parallel POST /api/tenant/invoices) and assert all invoice_number values match ^INV-\d{5}$, are unique (unique index idx_invoices_number on tenants+invoiceNumber), and are gap-safe/monotonic derived from MAX(sequence)+1 under a FOR UPDATE tenant lock with MAX_RETRIES=3 on 23505. Add an after-delete check: soft-delete the highest invoice (DELETE = deletedAt in app/api/tenant/invoices/[id]/route.ts) then create a new one; document expected behavior and the OBSERVATION from context.json that gap-safety holds because deletion is soft (MAX ignores nothing structurally but numbers persist). Note tests/integration/invoice-id.test.ts + the harness checkInvoiceNumbering already cover parts of this.

Add DUNNING cap/attemptNumber test subsection (#1464): POST /api/tenant/billing/dunning/retry (maxRetries+1) times for a subscription; assert dunning_attempts.attempt_number increments monotonically (MAX+1 across ALL attempts) and the (maxRetries+1)th call returns HTTP 400 'Maximum retry attempts'. maxRetries from dunning_settings.maxRetries (default 3). Note the cap counts ALL non-succeeded attempts and the subscription row is locked FOR UPDATE. IMPORTANT: include the context.json OBSERVATION that the retry route currently only records the attempt + billing event and does NOT yet re-charge Stripe (TODO in code) — so 'failed payment -> dunning' verifies attempt bookkeeping/cap, not an actual successful re-charge, in test mode.

Add CURRENCY/integer-cents subsection covering at least one non-USD currency: reference lib/money.ts (money/round2/lineTotal/sumLineItems round-half-up per step) and lib/billing/payments.ts (toCents). Use Razorpay INR paise (RAZORPAY_PLAN_PRICING, lib/razorpay.ts, e.g. starter month 149900 paise = 1,499 INR) as the non-USD integer-minor-unit example and Stripe cents (amount_total). Verify an invoice with line items reconciles: sum(line_items.total) + tax - discount == invoices.total_amount to the cent. Note the OBSERVATION that billingEvents.currency is hard-coded 'usd' in upgrade/dunning routes and service_subscriptions.currency defaults 'USD' (report as a currency-consistency risk, do not fix).

Add PRORATION subsection (#1477 scope): POST /api/tenant/billing/subscription/upgrade and .../downgrade proxy Stripe's proration (updateSubscription; proration happens in Stripe). Steps: upgrade starter->pro, inspect the Stripe test-mode invoice/proration line in the Stripe dashboard and compare to provider math; assert subscriptions.planId updated, status='active', currentPeriodStart/End synced from stripeSub, and a billingEvents row eventType='subscription.upgraded'. Note upgrade route rejects non-upgrades (priceMonthly must increase) and both require isStripeConfigured + admin. Razorpay/PayU: note proration is not implemented for those providers (verify) and mark accordingly.

Add 'Fix presence re-confirmation' section: a table mapping #1462/#1463/#1464/#1454 to file + approach so a tester can eyeball-confirm the fix is present BEFORE behavioral testing. #1462 -> app/api/tenant/invoices/route.ts (MAX(regex sequence)+1, SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on tenants, MAX_RETRIES=3 on 23505). #1463 -> app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts handleSubscriptionUpdated explicit status switch (~L160-195) + terminal-status guard. #1464 -> app/api/tenant/billing/dunning/retry/route.ts (count ne 'succeeded' for cap, attemptNumber = MAX+1, DunningCapReached, subscription FOR UPDATE). #1454 -> note it is lead->deal conversion (tangential to billing); cite where the lead-to-deal conversion lives if quickly locatable, otherwise mark 'verify (tangential, non-billing)'. Include a grep/read command per row so the tester can confirm.

Add an AUTOMATED-vs-MANUAL coverage matrix: for each scope item mark whether existing automated tests already cover it and cite the file. Automated: Stripe lifecycle (scripts/billing-lifecycle-test.ts via npm run test:billing; tests/unit/billing-lifecycle-harness.test.ts), Stripe signature/verify + tenant resolution (tests/unit/stripe.test.ts, tests/unit/billing/stripe-webhook-subscription-tenant.test.ts), invoice numbering (tests/integration/invoice-id.test.ts + harness), money math (tests/unit/money.test.ts, tests/unit/billing/invoice-payments.test.ts), Razorpay + PayU signature/hash unit logic (tests/unit/razorpay.test.ts, tests/unit/payu.test.ts), billing routes (tests/integration/api-routes-billing.test.ts). Manual test-mode required (no automated e2e): Razorpay full lifecycle, PayU full lifecycle, real Stripe test-clock renewal, proration math against provider dashboard, real refund flow. Recommend gaps (e.g. a Razorpay/PayU harness) WITHOUT writing test code.

Add SIGN-OFF / ACCEPTANCE section matching #1477 acceptance criteria: a filled-in run-through table (expected-vs-actual, empty actual column) plus explicit checkboxes that P0 bugs #1462/#1463/#1464/#1454 are re-verified. Add a 'Cannot be verified in test mode' subsection with closest proxies: real bank declines -> Stripe test card 4000000000000341 / pm_card_chargeCustomerFail forcing invoice.payment_failed; forced past_due/dunning -> `stripe trigger invoice.payment_failed`; real renewal timing -> Stripe test clocks (dashboard, manual per docs/billing-lifecycle-test.md §7); Razorpay/PayU declines -> provider test-mode failure simulations. Reference the specific Stripe test tokens used by the existing harness (pm_card_visa success, pm_card_chargeCustomerFail / PAN 4000000000000341 failure).

Throughout: use markdown tables/checklists; NO em dashes; use hyphens or rephrase. For any claim not directly confirmable in code, mark it '(verify)' rather than stating as fact (e.g. Razorpay/PayU proration absence). Keep the document self-contained and execution-ready for a QA engineer.
acceptance_criteria: File /projects/sandbox/nucrm-bigplan-by-vm-enterprise-v2/BILLING-VERIFICATION-PLAN-1477.md exists and is valid markdown (renders; prettier-clean so husky pre-commit passes).
All 8 #1477 scope items each have a dedicated section with trigger steps, DB table.column to inspect, expected result, and an empty Actual/Pass-Fail column.

A Stripe status-mapping matrix table is present covering active/trialing/past_due/canceled/unpaid/incomplete_expired/incomplete/paused/unknown -> expected tenants.status, matching the switch in app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts, plus the terminal-status guard row.
Provider-specific idempotency keys are stated exactly: Stripe stripe:evt:{id}, Razorpay razorpay:evt:{id} (24h TTL), PayU per-txnid on invoice_payments.reference.

Invoice-number concurrency + after-(soft)delete test and dunning cap/attemptNumber test are documented with exact endpoints and tables/columns (invoices.invoice_number, dunning_attempts.attempt_number).
A non-USD currency/integer-cents check is present using Razorpay INR paise and referencing lib/money.ts + lib/billing/payments.ts.
A 'Fix presence re-confirmation' section maps #1462/#1463/#1464/#1454 to file + approach with a verify command per row.
An automated-vs-manual coverage matrix cites the actual existing test files and distinguishes automated coverage from manual test-mode steps.
A sign-off/acceptance section matches the issue acceptance criteria and lists what cannot be verified in test mode with closest test-mode proxies.
No product code, test, or config files are modified: `git status` shows only the new markdown file (and .agents task files) staged.
No em dashes anywhere in the document.
verification: Run: ls -la /projects/sandbox/nucrm-bigplan-by-vm-enterprise-v2/BILLING-VERIFICATION-PLAN-1477.md and confirm it exists.
Run: grep -c 'INV-' and grep for each scope keyword to confirm all sections present; grep -n '—' BILLING-VERIFICATION-PLAN-1477.md returns nothing (no em dashes).
Run: cd repo && git status --porcelain and confirm ONLY BILLING-VERIFICATION-PLAN-1477.md (plus .agents/) are new/modified; no files under app/ lib/ tests/ drizzle/ changed.

Run husky pre-commit path implicitly by staging + committing on branch docs/1477-billing-verification-plan (Node via nvm first). Note: the coder subagent does NOT commit/push; leave the file staged-ready. Orchestrator/verifier handles commit.
findings: Created BILLING-VERIFICATION-PLAN-1477.md at repo root. All claims verified against source before writing: app/api/webhooks/{stripe,razorpay,payu}/route.ts, app/api/tenant/invoices/route.ts and [id]/route.ts, app/api/tenant/billing/dunning/retry/route.ts and subscription/upgrade/route.ts, lib/{money,razorpay,payu}.ts, lib/billing/payments.ts, drizzle/schema/{core,billing}.ts, .env.example, and the existing Stripe harness/runbook (scripts/billing-lifecycle-test.ts, docs/billing-lifecycle-test.md).
